blocks.prompt: 3. Consider the arithmetico-geometric sequence defined by arithmetic part: \(a_{n+1} = 2n + 5\) and geometric part: \(b_{n-2} = \frac{1}{9}(-3)^{n}\). Find the \(n^{\text{th}}\) term and the sum of first three terms of the arithmetico-geometric sequence.
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal ki khaas baat yeh hai ke formulas \(a_n\) aur \(b_n\) ke liye nahi, balki \(a_{n+1}\) aur \(b_{n-2}\) ke liye diye gaye hain. Yani subscript (neeche wala number) khiska hua hai.
Pehle hum har formula ko "shift" karenge taake subscript sirf \(n\) reh jaye. Phir A.G.P. ka term \(T_n = a_n b_n\) banega.
Plan: \(a_n\) nikalo, \(b_n\) nikalo, multiply karo, phir \(n = 1, 2, 3\) rakh kar teen terms jama karo.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_{n+1} = 2n + 5\), \(b_{n-2} = \frac{1}{9}(-3)^{n}\)
Humein find karna hai: \(T_n\) aur \(T_1 + T_2 + T_3\).
Tareeqa: \(n\) ki jagah aisi cheez rakho ke subscript \(n\) ban jaye; phir \(T_n = a_n b_n\). Yeh isi tarah hai jaise kisi function mein \(x\) ki jagah \(x - 1\) rakhte hain: formula wahi rehta hai, bas har jagah tabdeeli karni hoti hai.

\(a_n\) nikalein
\[a_{(n-1)+1} = 2(n - 1) + 5\]
\[a_n = 2n - 2 + 5\]
\[a_n = 2n + 3\]
Kyun: Subscript \(n + 1\) ko \(n\) banane ke liye \(n\) ki jagah \(n - 1\) rakha, kyunke \((n - 1) + 1 = n\). Yeh tabdeeli dono taraf karni zaroori hai, sirf left side par nahi. To A.P. part \(5, 7, 9, \ldots\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(a_n = 2n + 5\) seedha likh dena ghalat hai; woh to \(a_{n+1}\) hai.

\(b_n\) nikalein
\[b_n = \dfrac{1}{9}(-3)^{n+2}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{9}(-3)^{2}(-3)^{n}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{9} \cdot 9 \cdot (-3)^{n}\]
\[= (-3)^{n}\]
Kyun: Ab subscript \(n - 2\) ko \(n\) banana hai, is liye \(n\) ki jagah \(n + 2\) rakha. Phir qanoon \(x^{m+n} = x^m x^n\) se \((-3)^{n+2} = (-3)^2(-3)^n\) likha. \((-3)^2 = 9\) aur \(\frac{1}{9} \times 9 = 1\). To G.P. part \(-3, 9, -27, \ldots\) hai, ratio \(-3\).

\(T_n\) likhein
\[T_n = a_n b_n\]
\[= (2n + 3)(-3)^{n}\]
Kyun: A.G.P. ka \(n\)th term dono parts ke \(n\)th terms ka product hai. Yeh sawal ka pehla jawab hai.

Pehle teen terms
\[T_1 = 5(-3) = -15\]
\[T_2 = 7(9) = 63\]
\[T_3 = 9(-27) = -243\]
Kyun: \(n = 1, 2, 3\) rakha. \((-3)^1 = -3\), \((-3)^2 = 9\), \((-3)^3 = -27\).
Dhyan dein: negative number ki odd power negative aur even power positive hoti hai; signs mein ghalti yahan sab se zyada hoti hai.

Diye gaye formulas se tasdeeq
\[a_2 = 2(1) + 5 = 7 \;\checkmark\]
\[b_1 = \tfrac{1}{9}(-3)^{3} = -3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Diye gaye formula \(a_{n+1}\) mein \(n = 1\) rakhne se \(a_2 = 7\) aata hai, aur hamara \(a_n = 2n + 3\) bhi \(a_2 = 7\) deta hai. Isi tarah \(b_{n-2}\) mein \(n = 3\) rakhne se \(b_1 = -3\), jo hamare \(b_n = (-3)^n\) se bhi milta hai. Shift sahi hua.
